method: Compared baseline grade1 sections and all shared printables; reused verified identical material. Inspected grade-specific retrieval distractors, goals, group tasks and differentiated challenge instructions. Preserved grade-specific writing scaffolds. Reviewed safety and answer dependencies; fixed visible class practice instructions and printable text-choice layout.
qa: 642 HTML and 903 inline scripts across grades2-4: no script syntax errors or missing src assets. Local slide, key-popup and print samples inspected.
limitations: Targeted review, not individual factual and pixel inspection of every original slide.
